messages:
alex chen: Hey team — first week here, got Buildkite access but my first pipeline is failing on the image pull step. Any quick checks I should do?

maria lin: welcome! can you paste the build link and the error snippet? also did you accept the GitHub App invite for Redwood CI? sometimes that's the blocker.

alex chen: https://buildkite.com/redwood/my-service/builds/321
Error: Received status code 403 while fetching image from ECR

Step logs:
```
> docker pull 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/my-service:latest
ERROR: Denied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/buildkite-agent-role/i-0abcd is not authorized to perform: ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability on resource: arn:aws:ecr:us-east-1:123456789012:repository/my-service
```

maria lin: ok that looks like an IAM permission issue for the Buildkite agent. two common roots: (1) the Buildkite agent role missing ecr:GetAuthorizationToken/ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability or (2) pipeline expects a k8s secret for docker creds that doesn't exist. are you running on k8s agents or EC2 autoscale?

alex chen: we're on k8s agents (bk-us-east-1 cluster). i tried `aws ecr get-login-password | docker login` locally and it works, so creds exist for my user.

devops-bot: Reminder: Buildkite agents authenticate to ECR using the IAM role attached to the node or service account; local user creds won't affect cluster pods.

sachin patel: @alex chen i've seen this. i'll check the cluster rolebinding and the `buildkite-docker-creds` secret in `buildkite` namespace. alex — you probably don't have rights to view secrets yet.

jess ramos: also check org GH app — if your GH org SSO isn't approved it can block pipeline access to private repos/artifacts. CC @maria lin.

maria lin: @sachin can you grant alex `ci-developers` group access to the buildkite namespace or create the secret? quick command i usually run (ops only):
```
kubectl -n buildkite create secret generic buildkite-docker-creds \
  --from-file=.dockerconfigjson=/tmp/dockerconfig.json \
  --type=kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson
```
Make sure the secret name matches the pipeline's `imagePullSecrets` in the helm chart.

sachin patel: done — added alex to `ci-developers` and applied a RoleBinding for `edit` in the `buildkite` namespace. also recreated `buildkite-docker-creds` from the central CI key.

alex chen: retrying the build now...

(2 minutes later)

alex chen: ✅ it passed! the image pulled fine after the secret existed. thanks everyone. :tada:

maria lin: awesome. i'll add a short note to the eng-infra onboarding doc: check GH App invite + ensure `buildkite-docker-creds` exists when using k8s agents.

jess ramos: adding a checklist item to the new-hire CI section to verify org GH app + cluster secret + SSO.

alex chen: super helpful — appreciate the quick triage.
